description: Trial016 changes only ground-load-reserve quadrature relative to completed LR-synchronized trial013: mean of the four instantaneous exp(-max(F_ground_world_z,0)/(0.20*live_robot_weight)) costs, summed over two filtered wheels; not exp of mean force. Hold weight -1, last-substep wheel-vz, sideslip weight2, original500/10PD, original004 parent,600updates/2048envs/seed42, motor randomization, reference, friction, clocks and all behavior gates. The new opt-in handler reuses frozen native-window checks and also collects the inherited wheel-vz statistic without consuming it as a reward. No new teacher, physical step, actor call, observation, reset hook, contact-law fit or required50:50load split. Fresh GPU sampling, reset and performance checks precede learning. This soft reward does not certify uninterrupted bearing contact, force-model equivalence, hardware safety or statistical robustness.
